A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CORE research work. All 22 pages of each version, including Appendices A–D, are readable and support comparison; the rasterized Figure 2 in v2 was inspected visually.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations, conceptual diagnostics, robustness experiments and controlled comparisons in Tables 1–7, plus PPO results and a case study in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the main benchmark evaluations, diagnostic analyses and Appendix C results.

M1.justification: Section 3.4 and Appendix C.1 retain the same CORE-Base, trajectory-replacement, KL-regularization and PPO procedures. Equation (1) is unchanged. The conflicting KL notation newly introduced in Figure 2 does not establish a change to the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same textbook-derived training and evaluation coverage, external mathematical benchmarks, option-permutation and distractor scenarios, and Appendix C.1 evaluations including AMC23 and College Math.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Vanilla and SFT remain in Table 2, Random-Reward GRPO and Top 4 of 6 GRPO remain in Table 5, and CORE-Base + Verifier remains in Table 7. Appendix comparisons also match.

E3.justification: Both retain SC@21 at temperature 0.7, the 140-exercise textbook test, the same perturbation procedures and controls, and identical training budgets, model configurations and evaluation instructions in Appendix B.

E4.justification: The option-shuffling diagnostic, 19-problem concept-use audit, distractor robustness test, random-reward and top-k controls, self-generated-data experiment, verifier analysis and Appendix C.2 case study are retained. Figure 1 redisplays the same diagnostic example.

E5.justification: Section 5.2 retains the same single-seed distractor construction. Neither version adds repeated-training-run summaries, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests; uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 retain their results and example outputs, and Figure 3 retains identical curves. For example, Table 2's textbook accuracies remain 46.4% for Vanilla and 55.7% for CORE-KL; Appendix C's PPO results also match.

T1.justification: v2's Figure 2 newly displays D_KL(base || concept-guided), reversing the order in Equation (1), which specifies D_KL(concept-guided || base) in both versions. This introduces a non-equivalent mathematical expression and an internal inconsistency. Other definitions and Appendix C.1 derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about bridging the definition–application gap, improving conceptual reasoning and generalization, and supporting standard policy-gradient methods without architectural changes.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning concept selection, robustness and independence from a stronger teacher remain unchanged, as do the single-case qualification and data-use caveats. Figure 1's revised caption restates the interpretation already present in Section 3.3.1.

D1.justification: v2 removes the Reproducibility Statement's promise to provide a full repository with code, configurations and end-to-end training/evaluation scripts at camera-ready. Implementation details and Appendix B remain unchanged. This changes the stated release commitment, without establishing a change in actual repository availability.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion and positioning relative to BREAD and other approaches are unchanged. Bibliographic entries move across page boundaries without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 adds three stage headings to Figure 1, revises its caption, shortens Figure 2's caption and deletes the repository-release sentence. The main narrative and section sequence remain intact, with no extensive prose rewriting.

P2.justification: Figure 1 changes from paired dialogue rows to labeled stages. Figure 2 replaces the earlier vector flowchart with a colored raster diagram containing reorganized branches and additional annotations. These localized redesigns and associated page reflow leave Figure 3 and the table structures unchanged.

improvement.justification: Figure 1's labeled stages improve navigation, but v2's Figure 2 introduces a reversed KL expression that conflicts with the retained objective in Equation (1), reducing technical consistency. Removing the code-release commitment also reduces reproducibility information, although actual access cannot be inferred. These limited drawbacks outweigh the presentation benefit; the underlying empirical evidence remains intact.
